title: custom Chat spammer
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local can = false
local chatText = "swexty."

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.35)
frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.3)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.3)
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.1)
toggleBtn.Text = "START"
toggleBtn.TextScaled = true
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120,0,255)
toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox", frame)
textBox.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.25)
textBox.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.55)
textBox.Text = chatText
textBox.PlaceholderText = "Text"
textBox.TextScaled = true
textBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45,45,45)
textBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
textBox.BorderSizePixel = 0

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if can then
			pcall(function()
				ReplicatedStorage.ChatEvent:FireServer(chatText)
			end)
		end
		task.wait(0)
	end
end)

toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	can = not can
	if can then
		toggleBtn.Text = "STOP"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,60,60)
	else
		toggleBtn.Text = "START"
		toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120,0,255)
	end
end)

textBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	if textBox.Text ~= "" then
		chatText = textBox.Text
	end
end)
